import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Resultant.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

/-! Actual bounded polynomials, endowed with their coefficient norm.
No polynomial, derivative or determinant identity is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev Coeff (n : ℕ) := Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

instance coeffNormedAddCommGroup (n : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff n) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)
    (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective

instance coeffNormedSpace (n : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff n) :=
  NormedSpace.induced ℝ _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

/-- Retain exactly the coefficients of orders less than `n`. -/
def cut (n : ℕ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ i)

@[simp] theorem degreeLTEquiv_coeff {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) (i : Fin n) :
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ n p i = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] theorem cut_coeff (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin n) :
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = p.coeff i := by
  exact congrFun ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).apply_symm_apply (fun j : Fin n => p.coeff j)) i

@[simp] theorem cut_coe {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : cut n (p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  simp

/-- Coefficient truncation of the actual polynomial product, as a bilinear map. -/
def mulLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun p q => cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])))
    (by intros; simp [add_mul])
    (by intros; simp [smul_mul_assoc])
    (by intros; simp [mul_add])
    (by intros; simp [mul_smul_comm])

def mulCLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →L[ℝ] Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      (Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r)).toLinearMap.comp
      (mulLM m n r))

@[simp] theorem mulCLM_apply {m n r : ℕ} (p : Coeff m) (q : Coeff n) :
    mulCLM m n r p q = cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])) := rfl

/-- The linear inclusion of a polynomial of degree `< n` into degree `< n+1`. -/
def liftLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+1)).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype

def liftCLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (liftLM n)

lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_bound {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    ((Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))

@[simp] theorem coe_lift {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (liftCLM n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k < n+1
  · exact cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,hk⟩
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

def topMonomial (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  ⟨X^n, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩

def monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  topMonomial n + liftCLM n p

@[simp] theorem coe_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]) = X^n + (p : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [monicPoly, topMonomial]

lemma bounded_natDegree {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)

/-- The affine monic-coordinate map has the actual Frechet derivative equal
    to its coefficient inclusion, including the degree-zero case. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicPoly (liftCLM n) p := by
  exact (liftCLM n).hasFDerivAt.const_add (topMonomial n)

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/BlockJacobian.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
open Module

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- The derivative block occurring in polynomial numerator/denominator gluing. -/
def repeatedBlock (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E) +
      L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E))

@[simp] theorem repeatedBlock_apply (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    repeatedBlock L C x = (L x.1, C x.1 + L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF) (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, repeatedBlock]

/-- An exact determinant theorem: no nonsingularity assumptions on either block. -/
theorem det_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [toMatrix_repeatedBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, pow_two]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/Triangular.lean:
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual triangular linear maps, with fully specified coefficient bases. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def lowerBlock (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (E × F) →L[ℝ] (E × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F) + M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F))

@[simp] lemma lowerBlock_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (M : F →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × F) :
    lowerBlock L C M x = (L x.1, C x.1 + M x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap) (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, lowerBlock]

theorem det_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap).det *
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_lowerBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Triangular
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Block

/-! Actual conservative tree rate coordinates, with arbitrary finite size.
Vertices are topologically numbered from the designated leak/root 0.
The parameter at 0 is the leak; at every other vertex it is the transfer rate
toward its parent. No positivity or nonzero-rate premise is used below. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A finite rooted tree in a topological vertex numbering. Every nonroot
vertex i+1 has exactly one parent, with smaller vertex number. -/
structure OrderedTree (n : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin n → Fin (n+1)
  parent_le : ∀ i, (parent i).val ≤ i.val

abbrev VertexValues (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) → ℝ
abbrev EdgeValues (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev TreeRates (n : ℕ) := VertexValues n × EdgeValues n

lemma parent_ne_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i : Fin n) :
    t.parent i ≠ i.succ := by
  intro h
  have hle := t.parent_le i
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at this
  omega

/-- Parent-incidence matrix of the actual labelled tree. -/
def parentIncidence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun v e => if t.parent e = v then 1 else 0

/-- Derivative of c_e=a_e f_e with respect to the inward/diagonal parameters. -/
def childWeighted {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun e v => if e.succ = v then f e else 0

def parentCLM {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : EdgeValues n →L[ℝ] VertexValues n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (parentIncidence t))

@[simp] lemma parentCLM_apply {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM t f v = ∑ e, if t.parent e = v then f e else 0 := by
  simp [parentCLM, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    parentIncidence, ite_mul]

/-- Physical rate chart: d_v is the sum of all rates leaving v, and c_e is
exactly the product of the two opposed rates on edge e. -/
def rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (x.1 + parentCLM t x.2, fun e => x.1 e.succ * x.2 e)

def rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates n →L[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)) +
    (parentCLM t).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun e : Fin n =>
      x.1 e.succ • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))) +
      x.2 e • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))))

/-- The rate-coordinate Jacobian is derived from the actual polynomial map. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (rateChart t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  apply HasFDerivAt.prodMk
  · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt.add
      ((parentCLM t).hasFDerivAt.comp x
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt)
  · apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro e
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt

lemma toMatrix_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (parentIncidence t) (childWeighted x.2)
        (Matrix.diagonal fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rateChartDerivative, childWeighted,
      parentIncidence, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rename_i v j
  symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro e _ he
    simp [Ne.symm he]
  · simp

lemma childWeighted_mul_parent {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (childWeighted f * parentIncidence t) i j = if t.parent j = i.succ then f i else 0 := by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, childWeighted, parentIncidence, ite_mul, eq_comm]

lemma rateSchur_upperTriangular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t).IsUpperTriangular := by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : t.parent j ≠ i.succ := by
    intro h
    have hle := t.parent_le j
    have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ] at hh
    have hijv : j.val < i.val := hij
    omega
  have hneq : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt (show j < i from hij)
  simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, childWeighted_mul_parent,
    hne, hneq]

lemma rateSchur_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t) i i = x.1 i.succ := by
  simp [childWeighted_mul_parent, parent_ne_child]

/-- The exact physical-rate Jacobian, for every tree size and all real rates.
In particular, zero edges are not excluded by an inverse-rate calculation. -/
theorem det_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap).det = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [toMatrix_rateChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁,
    Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular (rateSchur_upperTriangular t x)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact rateSchur_diagonal t x i

/-- The true Frechet Jacobian, not a separately prescribed formal matrix. -/
def physicalRateJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (rateChart t) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem physicalRateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [physicalRateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

end HydrologyTree
